Package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis

Class ApisHandler

java.lang.Object
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.ApisHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class ApisHandler extends Object implements AutoCloseable
This class provides functions to perform operations with an OMERO server.

As different APIs are used to perform the operations, this class only redirects each web request to the appropriate API contained in this package.

An instance of this class must be closed once no longer used.

  • Constructor Details

    • ApisHandler

      public ApisHandler(URI webServerUri, Credentials credentials) throws URISyntaxException, ExecutionException, InterruptedException
      Create an APIs handler. This will send a few requests to get basic information on the server and authenticate if necessary, so it can take a few seconds. However, this operation is cancellable.
      Parameters:
      webServerUri - the URL to the OMERO web server to connect to
      credentials - the credentials to use for the authentication
      Throws:
      URISyntaxException - if a link to the server cannot be created
      ExecutionException - if a request to the server fails or if a response does not contain expected elements. This can happen if the server is unreachable or if the authentication fails for example
      InterruptedException - if the running thread is interrupted
      IllegalArgumentException - if the server doesn't return all necessary information on it
      NullPointerException - if the server doesn't return all necessary information

    • getImageUrisFromEntityURI

      public CompletableFuture<List<URI>> getImageUrisFromEntityURI(URI entityUri)
      Attempt to retrieve the image URIs indicated by the provided entity URI.
      • If the entity is a dataset, the URIs of the children of this dataset (which are images) are returned.
      • If the entity is a project, the URIs of each child of the datasets of this project are returned.
      • If the entity is an image, the input URI is returned.
      • If the entity is a well, the URIs of the child images of the well are returned.
      • If the entity is a plate acquisition, the URIs of the child images of each well contained in the plate acquisition are returned.
      • If the entity is a plate, the URIs of the child images of each well contained in the plate are returned.
      • If the entity is a screen, the URIs of the child images of each well contained in the child plates of the screen are returned.
      • Else, an error is returned.
      Note that exception handling is left to the caller (the returned CompletableFuture may complete exceptionally if the request or the conversion failed for example).
      Parameters:
      entityUri - the URI of the entity whose images should be retrieved. It can be URL encoded
      Returns:
      a CompletableFuture (that may complete exceptionally) with the list described above

    • deleteShapes

      public CompletableFuture<Void> deleteShapes(long imageId, List<Long> userIds)
      Delete all shapes of the provided image.

      Note that exception handling is left to the caller (the returned CompletableFuture may complete exceptionally if the request failed for example).

      Parameters:
      imageId - the ID of the image containing the shapes to delete
      userIds - the list of IDs of the users that should own the shapes to delete. If one provided ID is less than or equal to 0, all shapes of the provided image are deleted
      Returns:
      a void CompletableFuture (that completes exceptionally if the operation failed)
